comment: Deployment-owned, signed tool contract (SDD-OT-001 §4, D-05). REMORA is the sole authority that binds and verifies this spec at assess/dispatch time (INV-03). The bounds below are an additional declared constraint that MUST agree with the twin's local interlock (twin/guard.py); they never replace REMORA authorization. The signature block is applied in the protected deployment and is never committed to git.

signature.note: Deployment-owner attestation over the canonical spec (all keys except this block). Signed at deploy time with OT_TOOLSPEC_SIGNING_KEY; never commit a real key or value. REMORA's own binding of the signed ToolSpec is authoritative and separate from this attestation.
